package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

func producer(ctx context.Context, n int) <-chan int {
	out := make(chan int)
	go func() {
		defer close(out)
		for i := range n {
			select {
			case out <- i * i:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return
			}
		}
	}()
	return out
}

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	sum := 0
	for v := range producer(ctx, 5) {
		sum += v
	}
	cancel()
	fmt.Println("sum of squares:", sum)

	var mu sync.Mutex
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	var hits atomic.Int64
	seen := map[int]bool{}
	for i := 0; i < 20; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			hits.Add(1)
			mu.Lock()
			seen[i%5] = true
			mu.Unlock()
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	keys := make([]int, 0, len(seen))
	for k := range seen {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Ints(keys)
	fmt.Println("hits:", hits.Load(), "keys:", keys)

	timeout, stop := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Millisecond)
	defer stop()
	select {
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		fmt.Println("slow")
	case <-timeout.Done():
		fmt.Println("deadline:", timeout.Err())
	}

	results := make(chan string, 3)
	var once sync.Once
	for _, name := range []string{"a", "b", "c"} {
		go func() {
			once.Do(func() { results <- "first" })
			results <- name
		}()
	}
	got := []string{}
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		got = append(got, <-results)
	}
	sort.Strings(got)
	fmt.Println(got)
}
